ax2.set_ylabel('Total Spending ($)')

ax3.set_title('Purchase Channel Distribution', fontweight='bold')

ax4 = axes[1, 0]

ax4.set_xlabel('Count')
ax4.set_title('Education Level Distribution', fontweight='bold')

ax5.set_title('Average Spending by Marital Status', fontweight='bold')
ax5.set_ylabel('Average Total Spending ($)')
for bar, val in zip(bars, marital_spending.values):
    ax5.text(bar.get_x() + bar.get_width()/2, bar.get_height() + 10, f'${val:.0f}', ha='center', va='bottom', fontsize=9)

# 6. Kids/Teens at home vs Spending
ax6 = axes[1, 2]
df['HasChildren'] = (df['Kidhome'] + df['Teenhome']).apply(lambda x: 'Has Children' if x > 0 else 'No Children')
children_spending = df.groupby('HasChildren')['TotalSpending'].mean()
bars = ax6.bar(children_spending.index, children_spending.values, color=['#9b59b6', '#f1c40f'], edgecolor='black')
ax6.set_title('Spending: Children vs No Children', fontweight='bold')
ax6.set_ylabel('Average Total Spending ($)')
for bar, val in zip(bars, children_spending.values):

plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig('output.png', dpi=150, bbox_inches='tight', facecolor='white', edgecolor='none')
